pet_notes: A charming chubby giant panda inspired by the supplied reference: round white head and body, black ears, eye patches, arms and legs, rosy cheeks, tiny friendly smile, seated-friendly proportions, always carrying or holding a small leafy green bamboo sprig as a stable identity prop. The standard idle/waiting poses should read as sitting; directional running rows should read as a cute walk; the non-directional running row should show focused bamboo nibbling/eating; review should inspect a bamboo leaf; waving uses one paw while bamboo remains attached or tucked; preserve the same face, markings, bamboo prop, proportions, and soft storybook sticker rendering in every state.
style_notes: Soft hand-painted storybook sticker art, rounded plush-like volume, clean dark outlines, gentle blush, simple readable shapes, transparent-ready sprite production on the selected flat chroma key; no scenery, ground shadow, text, symbols, detached effects, or frame guides.
